title: Navy and White Smoke Colour Post
whatItIs: A portrait post split into a saturated navy upper half with white text 'Navy #000080' and a white smoke lower half with navy text 'White Smoke #F5F5F5', hex codes in outlined pills and a handle strip at the top.
whatItMeans: Each colour appears as background and as text for its partner, proving the pairing.
